name: make
description: Turn recurring work you spot in Codex into Make automations and AI Agents that keep running in the cloud. Build, run, and manage them from Codex, connected to the apps and data they need. Everything stays visible in Make's visual landscape, so you can inspect and change it anytime.

interface.shortDescription: Build Make scenarios with expert skills
interface.longDescription: Turn recurring work you spot in Codex into Make automations and AI Agents that keep running in the cloud. Build, run, and manage them from Codex, connected to the apps and data they need. Everything stays visible in Make's visual landscape, so you can inspect and change it anytime. If Codex does not register the MCP server automatically after install, run `codex mcp add make --url https://mcp.make.com/openai` and then `codex mcp login make`.
defaultPrompt: Build a Make scenario that sends a Slack message when a new row is added to Google Sheets.
Design a Make scenario that summarizes daily emails and posts the summary to Notion.
Explain what my "Invoice sync" scenario does and whether its connections are healthy.
